nodes.name: observer
notes: stock firmware, never flashed and never commanded DURING a run
provisioned once out of band, 2026-09-02, and not touched since:
modem_preset LONG_SLOW - on LONG_FAST it is on a different spreading factor and hears nothing the bench does
tx_enabled false, tx_power 10 - a passive witness must not key its transmitter; it also stays out of the duty-cycle budget
debug_log_api_enabled FALSE - this is the one that matters. With it on, logs go to whichever client attaches and raw serial sees nothing at all
a different board on purpose: it is the naive-client instrument, so it must not share the DUT's build
